agents.name: Market Research Agent
agents.description: Fetches real-time Nifty spot price, option chain data, implied volatility (IV), open interest (OI), support/resistance levels, and weekly trend analysis from public financial sources.

agents.name: Strategy Computation Agent
agents.description: Computes optimal F&O strategy parameters including strike selection, premium calculations, required margin/capital, max profit, max loss, breakeven points, and probability of profit (POP) based on market data.

agents.name: Strategy Advisor Agent
agents.description: Synthesizes market research and computed strategy data into a clear, actionable recommendation with risk warnings, capital allocation advice, win/loss probability assessment, and trade/no-trade verdict.

agents.name: Nifty Strategy Coordinator
agents.description: Coordinates sub-agents to research market data, compute strategy parameters, and synthesize a final weekly F&O strategy recommendation. Routes user inputs, aggregates all sub-agent outputs into one cohesive strategy report.
